<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Pagină-1" id="vWR3Y8U4rHYtrny4ng1T"> <mxGraphModel dx="1414" dy="795" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml UC3_Events
 left to right direction
 skinparam packageStyle rectangle
 skinparam actorStyle awesome

 actor Owner
 actor Organizer
 Owner <|-- Organizer

 rectangle \"DogApp – 3. Events\" {
 ' --- Organizer ---
 usecase \"Create event\" as UC_Create
 usecase \"Create playdate\n(PRIVATE)\" as UC_Playdate
 usecase \"Create group walk /\nbreed meetup (PUBLIC)\" as UC_PublicEvent
 usecase \"Enter location text\" as UC_LocationText
 usecase \"Choose / create Place\" as UC_ChoosePlace
 usecase \"Invite owners\" as UC_Invite
 usecase \"Edit event\" as UC_Edit
 usecase \"Cancel event\" as UC_Cancel
 usecase \"Notify participants\" as UC_Notify

 ' --- Participant ---
 usecase \"Browse events nearby\n(list / map)\" as UC_Browse
 usecase \"View event details\" as UC_Details
 usecase \"RSVP with dog(s)\" as UC_Rsvp
 usecase \"Change / cancel RSVP\" as UC_ChangeRsvp
 usecase \"Check capacity\n(maxParticipants = dogs)\" as UC_Capacity
 usecase \"Respond to invitation\" as UC_RespondInvite
 usecase \"View participants\" as UC_Participants
 usecase \"Open event chat\n(→ 2. Social)\" as UC_EventChat
 usecase \"Review place\n(→ 5. Map)\" as UC_Review
 usecase \"Exclude blocked users\" as UC_ExcludeBlocked
 }

 Organizer --> UC_Create
 Organizer --> UC_Edit
 Organizer --> UC_Cancel

 Owner --> UC_Browse
 Owner --> UC_Details
 Owner --> UC_RespondInvite

 UC_Playdate ..> UC_Create : <<extend>>
 UC_PublicEvent ..> UC_Create : <<extend>>
 UC_Playdate ..> UC_LocationText : <<include>>
 UC_Playdate ..> UC_Invite : <<include>>
 UC_PublicEvent ..> UC_ChoosePlace : <<include>>
 UC_Invite ..> UC_Edit : <<extend>>

 UC_Edit ..> UC_Notify : <<include>>
 UC_Cancel ..> UC_Notify : <<include>>

 UC_Browse ..> UC_ExcludeBlocked : <<include>>
 UC_Details ..> UC_Browse : <<extend>>
 UC_Rsvp ..> UC_Details : <<extend>>
 UC_Rsvp ..> UC_Capacity : <<include>>
 UC_ChangeRsvp ..> UC_Details : <<extend>>
 UC_RespondInvite ..> UC_Rsvp : <<include>>
 UC_Participants ..> UC_Details : <<extend>>
 UC_EventChat ..> UC_Details : <<extend>>
 UC_Review ..> UC_Details : <<extend>>

 note right of UC_Browse
 Only PUBLIC + ACTIVE events.
 PRIVATE ones are visible
 only to invited owners.
 end note

 note right of UC_ChoosePlace
 Only PUBLIC events create
 or reuse a Place.
 Private playdates never
 appear on the map.
 end note

 note bottom of UC_Review
 Available only after endsAt,
 only for participants who
 were GOING. One review per
 (user, event).
 end note
 @enduml",
 "config": null
